paper_metadata.title: Effect of Solution Temperature on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Ti–5Al5Mo5V3Cr1Zr Alloy

evidence.quote: The Ti –5Al5Mo5V3Cr1Zr (Ti-55 531) alloy, which is a variant of the analogous Ti–5Al5Mo5V3Cr0.5Fe (Ti-5553) alloy,[4] is a relatively new metastable β titanium alloy with high strength and toughness based on the Ti–5Al5Mo5V1Cr1Fe (VT22) alloy.[5]
